echo_multiblock.tooltip.anchor: Place at the front-left bottom corner. Clear the entire volume. Breaking any part removes the machine.
echo_multiblock.place.bounds: Cannot place: the entire machine must fit inside world and build-height limits.
echo_multiblock.place.unloaded: Cannot place: every chunk occupied by the machine must be loaded.
echo_multiblock.place.occupied: Cannot place: every cell must be replaceable and contain no block entity.
echo_multiblock.place.permission: Cannot place: you need building permission for every cell of the machine.
echo_multiblock.place.collision: Cannot place: the machine would collide with a player or entity.
echo_multiblock.place.changed: Placement cancelled: the space changed. This placement was rolled back.
